ai.description: *Cnemaspis otai* is a small gecko (SVL ~35 mm) with a brown dorsum, yellow-spotted flanks, and a pale throat. It features a distinct black patch on the scapular region and a series of dark vertebral spots.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Cnemaspis otai* is best distinguished by the presence of a distinct, bright yellow or orange patch on the throat, which is absent in most other sympatric Indian species.
ai.habitat: The Vellore Day Gecko inhabits rocky outcrops and boulder-strewn areas within dry deciduous forests, typically found at elevations between 200 and 400 meters.
ai.behavior: The Vellore Day Gecko is primarily nocturnal, emerging at night to forage for small insects on rocky surfaces and tree trunks within its habitat.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Cnemaspis otai* is oviparous, typically laying a single-egg clutch. Breeding occurs year-round, with peak activity observed during the monsoon and post-monsoon seasons.
ai.distributionRemarks: Cnemaspis otai is endemic to the southern Eastern Ghats in Tamil Nadu, India, specifically inhabiting rocky outcrops at elevations between 250 and 1,100 meters.
